bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas, card surfaces, dark-section text — warm off-white that keeps the page from feeling clinical

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text on light canvas, dark-section backgrounds, inverse-surface text — near-black with a barely-perceptible green undertone

carbon.$description: Carbon — Hairline borders, dividers, link strokes — the structural outline color; appears 1340× as border, defining every panel edge

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary borders, inactive dividers — a step lighter than Carbon for de-emphasized edges

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted helper text, secondary metadata, label text — sits at AA on dark and fails on light, so it belongs in the dark sections and monospace stamps

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

bagoss-standard.$description: Primary typeface for headings, subheadings, and body — weights 385 and 520 are near-custom; the 520 medium at 59-63px with -0.02em tracking is the display voice, the 400 at 14-20px is body

general-grotesque-mono.$description: All-caps metadata, category labels, footer blocks — the 0.10em positive tracking at 9-10px is the signature stamp: every nav item, tagline, and micro-label uses it
